messages:
maria: Hey infra — onboarding new acct in eu-west-3 (France). Need VNet + subnet layout for Dedicated GPU clusters, NAT capacity, and A100 quota increases in francecentral & westeurope for cross-region failover. Who can help?

jake: cc @cloud-ops-bot - can you list current limits? Also how many public IPs do you think?

cloud-ops-bot: Current default public IP per subscription is 8 static public IPs. NAT gateway recommended per-AZ with multiple public IPs to avoid SNAT exhaustion. Raising if needed via support.

maria: We expect to start with 24 A100s (dedicated) in eu-west-3, plan to scale to 72 within 3 months. Each node will host ~6 pods, so ~432 pods total at scale. Many pods make outbound calls to third-party APIs (short-lived connections).

jake: Quick math: ephemeral port space ~60k per IP but real-world limits are lower due to connection churn. I think we should request 8 extra public IPs and 2 NAT gateways across AZs. Also open quota request for 100 A100s to be safe.

leo: We also need PrivateLink endpoints for log ingestion and our S3-compatible object store. That will require service endpoint subscription and subnet with /26 at minimum.

maria: Proposed CIDRs:
```VNet: 10.240.0.0/16
- compute-prod: 10.240.10.0/22 (AKS nodes)
- infra-services: 10.240.20.0/24 (NAT, AGW)
- privatelink: 10.240.30.0/26 (endpoints)
- pods: 10.240.40.0/18
```

cloud-ops-bot: Raised support ticket 2392849: A100 quota increase request (FranceCentral & WestEurope) -> request submitted, ETA 48-72h. Also created ticket 2392850 for additional Public IPs + NAT gateway quota.

jake: :thumbsup: Please add estimated monthly cost delta for finance approval.

tina: Rough estimate: each static Public IP ~€4.5/month, NAT gateway ~€80/month per gateway, A100 reserved cost not locked here but expect ~€11k/month per GPU on on-demand — will need precise quote. Approve provisional budget for networking (10 IPs + 2 NAT) ~€200/month; GPU cost still TBD.

maria: Thanks. Also note we want cross-region failover via peering to westeurope — need peering routes and Azure PrivateLink service configured. Can someone draft required IAM roles for the cloud-ops runbook?

leo: I'll write the runbook. Roles: Network Contributor on VNet, Owner on subscription for peering setup, Managed Identity for AKS with Contributor on target subnets. Will post draft.

azure-support-bot: Update on ticket 2392849: quota approved for 100 A100 family cores in francecentral, westeurope pending. Public IP increase approved +8. NAT gateway quota change scheduled.

maria: :eyes: Great. Follow-up: can we get the NAT gateway HA diagram + runbook link once Leo posts?

leo: Posting runbook link once draft is in docs. I'll include failover steps and cost calc. ETA EOD.

jake: Assigning action items: @leo write runbook, @cloud-ops-bot track tickets, @tina confirm GPU budget. I'll open infra PR for VNet CIDR.

cloud-ops-bot: Tickets tracked: 2392849, 2392850. Will ping if support asks for subscription ID.

maria: Thanks team. I'll add subscription/account IDs to the tickets and attach the CIDR plan.
